BiblicalUsage: Malakia is disease, debility, the sickness that wears a body down, and it appears only where Jesus is healing it. Matthew 4:23 says He went about all Galilee healing all manner of sickness and all manner of disease, and Matthew 9:35 says the same of all the cities and villages, while Matthew 10:1 gives the twelve power to heal all manner of sickness and all manner of disease.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the point of this word is who holds the power over it: disease is real, and Jesus heals it wherever He goes. My position is that Matthew 10:1 is the commission that follows, because the healing Jesus did, His disciples were sent to do.
